load_and_preprocess_images_crop: load and preprocess a list of images using crop mode to 518px width with center crop
load_and_preprocess_images_pad: load and preprocess a list of images using pad mode to 518px square with white padding
load_and_preprocess_images_rgba: load and preprocess RGBA images by compositing onto a white background before tensor conversion
load_and_preprocess_images_batch: load and preprocess multiple images into a batched tensor with shape N, 3, H, W
load_and_preprocess_images_single: load and preprocess a single image ensuring the output tensor has shape 1, 3, H, W
